events.body:
Evaluate whether the source-of-truth desktop node should automatically push refs to every registered mirror over SSH. Keep this disabled until the threat model and operational design are reviewed.

Security requirements:
- authorize each canonical node repository independently; do not treat an organization alias as authority for every node
- use per-node scoped keys or short-lived credentials with least privilege and clean revocation
- pin host identities and fail closed on key or route changes
- prevent a compromised mirror from becoming a source of truth or affecting sibling mirrors
- bound concurrency, timeouts, ref namespaces, repository size, and retry behavior
- preserve signed audit records without logging credentials
- define partial-failure behavior so one unavailable node does not block healthy mirrors
- require explicit owner opt-in and make node membership changes race-safe

Compare direct per-node SSH delivery with a hardened gateway fan-out design. Include migration, rollback, testing, and documentation before implementation.
events.title: Security review: source-of-truth SSH fan-out to every mirror node
